fixes.proposed: Open Premiere Pro, go to Settings › Media Cache (Preferences › Media Cache in older versions) and click Delete, ideally before you open a project. The files live in ~/Library/Application Support/Adobe/Common/Media Cache Files and can grow to 100GB+. Premiere regenerates them, so clearing them is safe. Final Cut Pro render files are cleared separately, below.

fixes.proposed: System Data is the storage macOS doesn't sort into Applications, Documents or Photos, and you can't delete it as a whole. Most of it is caches, logs, temporary files and snapshots. The parts in your own Library, such as caches and logs, are safe to remove with their apps quit. Leave /System, /Library and /private/var alone.
